澳大利亚毕业生临时签证 485（职业教育类别 / Post-Vocational: Australia Temporary Graduate visa 485 (Post-Vocational Education Work stream)
485 毕业生临时签证下面向**职业教育**毕业生的类别（与同签证下给本科及以上: The 485 Temporary Graduate visa stream for graduates of **vocational education** (a separate channel from the Post-Higher Education Work stream of the same visa, which covers bachelor degrees and above). It is for people who completed an associate degree, diploma or trade qualification in Australia. Stay of up to 18 months; holders of a Hong Kong or BNO passport may stay 5 years. You must apply within 6 months of being awarded the qualification while you are in Australia, and you must obtain a skills assessment from the relevant assessing authority. The age limit is 35; holders of a Hong Kong or BNO passport may be under 50.
官方资格按「在澳完成的学历类别 + 年龄 + 英语 + 技能评估」判定，未按国籍: Eligibility is decided officially on the qualification completed in Australia, age, English and skills assessment, with no nationality restriction, so holders of a mainland Chinese passport may apply. The threshold sits in the prior status: you must already have completed an associate degree, diploma or trade qualification in Australia and be in Australia when you apply. Holders of a Hong Kong or BNO passport get wider treatment (under 50 at application, a 5-year stay).

Mainland Chinese passport holders fall under the 35 limit.

Official wording: `You must have been awarded at least one associate degree, diploma or trade qualification in the 6 months immediately before the day you apply for your visa`. This is a separate channel from the Post-Higher Education Work stream of the same visa (bachelor and above) — this stream is aimed at vocational education backgrounds, not at bachelor or master graduates.
